member.name: MarkdownEmitter.Remarks
member.para: The Markdig parse and the toolkit-neutral mapping decisions live in the shared ; this emitter only resolves the toolkit concerns (fonts, brushes, element types) while it walks the model. Code blocks are delegated to .

All members create and touch the toolkit's elements and must run on the UI thread that owns the target elements. The caller owns text normalization and the plain-text fallback behavior; a parsing or rendering failure propagates to the caller.
